svg.title: Buff Your Money: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Open an app and type every expense, then give up after a few weeks. After: Send one chat line; BYM files amount, category, wallet and date. Before: Monthly budgets that ignore when the salary arrives. After: Periods follow payday, with a daily safe-to-spend figure. Before: Bank login sync that is unlicensed or breaks. After: Statement import from PDF, CSV or Excel with a preview before anything is saved. Before: Zakat and the tax-return asset list worked out by hand once a year. After: Zakat computed from the book; asset and debt list with tax codes ready to copy. Before: A chatbot that answers money questions with numbers it made up. After: The agent must call BYM tools; every number comes from deterministic code. Before: Changes made by an AI are hard to trace or reverse. After: Every agent change is logged and can be undone for 30 days.
svg.text: What changed for the people who use it.

Send one chat line; BYM files amount, category, wallet and date
Monthly budgets that ignore when the salary arrives
Periods follow payday, with a daily safe-to-spend figure
Bank login sync that is unlicensed or breaks
Statement import from PDF, CSV or Excel with a preview before anything
Zakat and the tax-return asset list worked out by hand once a year
Zakat computed from the book; asset and debt list with tax codes ready
A chatbot that answers money questions with numbers it made up
The agent must call BYM tools; every number comes from deterministic
Changes made by an AI are hard to trace or reverse
Every agent change is logged and can be undone for 30 days
